name: [TRADING FIXED + SALE] YBA: Reborn
desc:
USE CODE "Prestige3" FOR MAX LEVEL

Welcome to YBA: Reborn, this a PvP orientated game that focuses on smooth and quality combat. Talk to Giorno Giovanna when you spawn in to begin the storyline, where you'll learn the game and earn cosmetic rewards on the way.

CONTROLS (You can change some of these in your settings)
Q - Summon stand (Requires a stand)
F - Block
P - Pose
Left Alt - Dash
Left Control - Start running

scripts.title: Auto item picker
scripts.features: picks up items for yba reborn
scripts.script:
-- \\ main toggle
getgenv().itempicker = true

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Root = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local ItemsFolder = Workspace.Item_Spawns.Items

if not ItemsFolder then
    warn("Items folder not found!")
end

local TweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(
    0.5,
    Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
    Enum.EasingDirection.Out
)

local function moveTo(targetCFrame)
    if not targetCFrame then
        warn("moveTo: Invalid CFrame provided")
        return
    end

    local Goal = { CFrame = targetCFrame }
    local Tween = TweenService:Create(Root, TweenInfo, Goal)
    Tween:Play()
    Tween.Completed:Wait()
end

spawn(function()
    while true do
        if getgenv().itempicker and ItemsFolder then
            for _, Item in ipairs(ItemsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if getgenv().itempicker then
                    if Item:IsA("Model") then
                        local cframe

                        if Item.PrimaryPart then
                            cframe = Item.PrimaryPart.CFrame
                        else
                            local part = Item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Part")
                            if part then
                                cframe = part.CFrame
                            end
                        end

                        if cframe then
                            moveTo(cframe)
                            task.wait(0.25)

                            local clickDetector = Item:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
                            if clickDetector then
                                fireclickdetector(clickDetector, 4)
                                print("item clicked: ", Item.Name)
                            else
                                warn("no ClickDetector foud for item", Item.Name)
                            end

                            task.wait(1)
                        else
                            warn("no pos foud for item", Item.Name)
                        end

                    elseif Item:IsA("Part") then
                        moveTo(Item.CFrame)
                        task.wait(0.25)

                        local clickDetector = Item:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
                        if clickDetector then
                            fireclickdetector(clickDetector, 4)
                            print("item clicked: ", Item.Name)
                        else
                            warn("no ClickDetector foud for item:", Item.Name)
                        end

                        task.wait(1)
                    else
                        warn("error, object: ", Item.Name)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        task.wait()
    end
end)

scripts.title: Autofarm script with Auto Meteorite
scripts.features:
🎯 Selectable AutoFarm Mode

Choose a specific item from the dropdown to farm only that item.

Teleports under the item using TP spam and NoClip, then clicks it automatically.

Returns to original position after pickup.

🔥 Full AutoFarm Mode

Ignores dropdown and farms all items from a predefined list.

Uses NoClip, teleporting, and ClickDetector activation.

♻️ AutoSell System

Multi-select dropdown to choose which items to auto-sell.

If one of the selected items is in your backpack, the script:

Equips it automatically.

Interacts with the in-game merchant using RemoteEvents.

Fully toggleable on/off from the Sell tab.

☄️ Meteorite AutoCollector
    Auto collects meteorites in miliseconds
